query:
SELECT l.id, l.nome, l.colunaId, c.nome as colunaNome, l.createdAt
FROM leads l
LEFT JOIN colunas_pipeline c ON l.colunaId = c.id
WHERE l.nome LIKE '%Iago%'
ORDER BY l.createdAt;
